race.description: Nutrien Equine Nsw Breeders Challenge Blue- 2yo Fillies Heat One
race.comment: Classy filly BIRDSONG (5) was brave when third in the Breeders Challenge 2F Final last start after drawing wide and working. That was her first defeat of the campaign and she had won her other three attempts at this circuit and distance. She is a level above these. PAIGES BOULDER (8) went back last start then worked home in good style as the favourite to score by 2 metres at Newcastle over 1609m when returning from a break. Interesting to see what unfolds from this wide draw. Tackles a smart one but can feature. GUNNAREASON (6) will find this easier than her last attempt in the Breeders Challenge final and was racing consistently prior. HIGHVIEW BONNIE (9) is worth including off a win in a Breeders Challenge heat here three back.
